name: retail-brands
label: Retail & eCommerce Brands
description: Targets VP/Director/Head of eCommerce, Digital, and Merchandising leaders at retail and consumer brand companies. Secondary criteria — useful for expanding into direct client relationships.
_retail_brand_guidance:
Score retail/DTC/consumer brand leads on two axes — platform signal and seniority — rather than a single confirmation gate:

**Platform confirmed (strong, current):** Company explicitly uses Shopify Plus or NetSuite/SuiteCommerce — signal in their current role, company About, or tech stack ('Built our Shopify Plus store', 'our store runs SuiteCommerce'). Any qualifying title becomes eligible for warm-to-hot. Past-role mentions ('has worked with Shopify') do NOT count.

**Platform implied (ecommerce-native brand, no explicit mention):** DTC-first company in apparel, beauty, sportswear, or consumer electronics with evident digital-first positioning. Indirect signals: Shopify ecosystem tools (Klaviyo, Gorgias, Loop Returns), multi-currency/warehouse NetSuite use case, Series B+ funding as DTC brand. Only qualifies at C-suite or VP level (CEO, CTO, CPO, VP Ecommerce, VP Digital) — score as low warm (45–55).

**No signal:** Generic retail with brick-and-mortar focus, vague 'omnichannel' without specific platform, or below Director-level seniority — classify cold regardless of title.
_excluded_employers_note: This criteria targets people at retail and consumer BRANDS. Employees of the commerce platform vendors themselves (Shopify, Oracle/NetSuite, Salesforce, Adobe, BigCommerce) are not brands and not leads — classify cold, cap score at 25, regardless of seniority. Detect from the headline when company fields are null: 'at Shopify', '@ Shopify', 'at Oracle', 'at NetSuite'.
_excluded_companies_note: Operator feedback 2026-06-09 (SuiteDB) and 2026-07-27 (Seibert Consulting Group): absolutely no interest in engaging with these agencies under any circumstances — never surface anyone from these firms in any tier, in any criteria. Unlike excluded_employers (surfaced cold), these are dropped entirely at Step 2 — skip the result AND write it to seen.json so it never resurfaces. Detect from headline naming the firm; Seibert Consulting Group's staff may abbreviate as 'SCG' in headlines (e.g. 'at SCG') — treat that alongside any Seibert/NetSuite/Shopify Plus context as the same exclusion.
